variants.name: default
variants.what: B23 columns, base acceleration = record x 9.8, stiffness-proportional damping on the columns, dt = 5 ms

variants.name: alpha_mass
variants.what: mass-proportional damping on the point mass (acts on the absolute velocity when the base moves: +1.8 % displacement)

variants.name: fixed_base_force
variants.what: fixed base, inertia force -m a_g(t) on the mass

variants.name: record_as_ms2
variants.what: record in g used as m/s2

variants.name: first_column_only
variants.what: only the first of the five values per line read

variants.name: dt_misread
variants.what: record time step taken as 0.02 s

variants.name: alpha_on_columns
variants.what: mass-proportional damping on the massless column material: undamped response

variants.name: flexible_beam
variants.what: beam as flexible as the columns

variants.name: absolute_reported
variants.what: correct ODB, absolute roof displacement reported
